categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four business segments: titanium alloy precision casting, rubber and sealing materials, aircraft cockpit transparent components, and high-temperature alloy master alloys. These segments focus on aerospace applications including aircraft engines, airframes, helicopters, and spacecraft, while also serving industries such as shipbuilding, weaponry, electronics, nuclear, railways, chemical, automotive, and biomedical fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including precision casting of titanium alloys with high dimensional accuracy and complex structures, specialized rubber formulations for sealing and vibration damping, manufacturing of organic and inorganic glass transparent cockpit components with optical and mechanical performance, and vacuum induction melting and casting of high-temperature superalloys. It integrates digital simulation, additive manufacturing, and strict quality control systems such as NADCAP certification to ensure product reliability and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international aerospace engine and aircraft manufacturers, military and defense sectors, and civil aviation companies. The company also serves downstream industries like shipbuilding, nuclear power, automotive, and biomedical sectors. Major clients include China Aviation Industry Group, China Aviation Engine Group, Safran, Honeywell, and other global aerospace firms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with significant sales to domestic aerospace and defense customers. It also has international market presence through long-term contracts with foreign customers, including a major international client with a contract valued at approximately RMB 2.1 billion from 2025 to 2030. Export sales account for a smaller portion of revenue compared to domestic sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and upstream segments of the aerospace materials supply chain, focusing on research, development, and manufacturing of advanced aerospace materials and components. It supplies critical structural and functional materials to aircraft and engine manufacturers, positioning itself as a key materials and parts supplier within the aerospace manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation-driven development, focusing on advanced aerospace materials such as high-strength titanium alloys, high-performance rubber sealing materials, multifunctional transparent cockpit components, and high-temperature superalloys. The company emphasizes digitalization, additive manufacturing, and green manufacturing. It actively pursues 'unblocking' key technological bottlenecks through targeted R&D projects, patent applications, and collaboration with academic and research institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aerospace materials and components, including titanium alloy castings, rubber and sealing products, transparent cockpit components, and high-temperature alloy master alloys. The company also earns income from processing services and technical service contracts. Sales are mostly conducted via direct sales channels, including bidding and long-term framework agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically in aerospace materials, especially in titanium alloy precision casting and high-temperature alloy master alloys. It is among the few domestic suppliers capable of batch production for international civil aviation titanium alloy castings. Competitors include global aerospace materials suppliers such as PCC, Howmet Aerospace, Safran, Honeywell, PPG, and Dow Corning. The company maintains competitive advantages through proprietary technologies and comprehensive product portfolios.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.93 billion, representing a 4.62% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 581 million, a 0.84% increase. R&D investment increased by 18.78% to RMB 242 million, accounting for 8.26% of revenue. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 11.73 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 10.36 billion, reflecting steady growth and solid financial scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive technological capabilities, including advanced precision casting, specialized rubber formulations, and integrated transparent component manufacturing with proprietary intellectual property. It offers high-quality, reliable aerospace materials with international certifications and standards compliance. Its products provide superior performance in harsh aerospace environments, supporting national strategic needs and enabling domestic substitution for imported materials, thereby delivering high value and competitive differentiation.
